fact: The NIA's Acting Executive Secretary said on 21 September 2025 that the National Identification System relies on its PPP partner Margins ID Group for technical expertise, system maintenance and card production, and that NIA alone could not repair equipment quickly under government procurement rules.

The analyst says NITA, mandated under Act 771 to provide core government IT infrastructure, runs the Government Cloud (G-Cloud) and the NITA Data Centre that ministries, departments and agencies can host on or bypass.

Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh says the Ministry of Health's LHIMS, under a 2019 $100 million contract, was built and run by India's Lightwave with Ghana's health data hosted on servers in India, outside state control.
The Ghana News Agency reports that the CitizenApp Data Interoperability System, an upgrade of Ghana.gov, was developed by the Ghana Revenue Authority and NITA with other state agencies.
The Vice President launched the CitizenApp Data Interoperability System on 7 October 2024; it was developed by the Ghana Revenue Authority and NITA, and no contractor is named.
